title: Fix the HarmonyOS release build: it was shipping a debuggable HAP, and add a re-attach path
checklist: reproduced: -p buildMode=release produced a HAP whose module.json says buildMode=debug / debug=true, because product-level buildOption.debuggable=true applies to every mode

debuggable moves into the module buildOptionSet (true for debug, false for release) since the schema default is true; the dangling obfuscation-rules.txt reference is dropped (the file never existed; hvigor only skipped it because the build was debuggable)
both modes re-verified by a real local build: release -> buildMode=release/debug=false with DSH_RELEASE strip intact; debug -> buildMode=debug/debug=true
release.yml gains a release_tag dispatch input so packages can be rebuilt and re-attached to an existing release without deleting it
gov run green; PR opened; gates check green; squash merged; the corrected HAP replaces the bad asset on v0.0.1

void.reason: Mission DELIVERED in #98 (squash a5f26a6), retired as void per the repo's recorded exit (govrail 0.47.1 close stamps a receipt the task gate then rejects — verify-decisions NOT_SELECTED, #329/#339). Checklist verified: the product-level buildOption.debuggable=true that applied to EVERY buildMode was moved into the module's per-mode buildOptionSet (true for debug, false for release, explicit in both because the schema default is true); the dangling ./obfuscation-rules.txt reference was dropped (it never existed — hvigor only skipped it while the build was debuggable); a new release.yml guard reads the built HAP's module.json and refuses unless debug=false and buildMode=release, proven BOTH directions against real artifacts; release_tag dispatch input added so packages rebuild and re-attach to an existing release. The corrected HAP replaced the bad asset on v0.0.1 — run 35586338946 printed 'release HAP: debug=False buildMode=release' and the dsh-harmony.hap asset carries updatedAt 2026-09-21T10:01:13Z. Audit trail: the merged PR + the live release.
